### 1. Architecture Overview
Across the four projects, every custom API group uses the standard Kubernetes scheme registration pattern. Each `register.go` (or `groupversion_info.go`) file defines a `GroupVersion`, a `SchemeBuilder`, and exposes `AddToScheme` so controllers/webhooks can install their CRD types. Inside each file an `addKnownTypes(scheme *runtime.Scheme)` calls `scheme.AddKnownTypes(SchemeGroupVersion, <list of CR types>...)`. If `runtime.Scheme.AddKnownTypes` changes to require a typed `TypeRegistration` instead of variadic objects, all these registration functions will break until they are updated to pass the new struct.

### 2. Detailed Analysis
- **cert-manager (repo: cert-manager)**  
  All internal and versioned API groups register CRD types with `scheme.AddKnownTypes`:
  - `pkg/apis/certmanager/v1/register.go` calls `scheme.AddKnownTypes(SchemeGroupVersion, &Certificate{}, &CertificateList{}, &Issuer{}, &IssuerList{}, &ClusterIssuer{}, &ClusterIssuerList{}, &CertificateRequest{}, &CertificateRequestList{})` (lines 49-59) – would fail under a new signature.  
    Source: `pkg/apis/certmanager/v1/register.go` lines 45-60.
  - Similar internal registrations (metadata only, same pattern) in:
    - `internal/apis/acme/register.go` (addKnownTypes registers Order/Challenge types)
    - `internal/apis/certmanager/register.go`
    - `internal/apis/config/cainjector/register.go`
    - `internal/apis/config/controller/register.go`
    - `internal/apis/config/webhook/register.go`
    - `internal/apis/meta/register.go`
    - Webhook and versioned configs: `pkg/acme/webhook/apis/acme/v1alpha1/register.go`, `pkg/apis/acme/v1/register.go`, `pkg/apis/config/cainjector/v1alpha1/register.go`, `pkg/apis/config/controller/v1alpha1/register.go`, `pkg/apis/config/webhook/v1alpha1/register.go`, `pkg/apis/meta/v1/register.go`.

- **external-secrets (repo: external-secrets)**  
  Scheme registration uses controller-runtime’s `SchemeBuilder.AddToScheme` and `Register`, which internally still call `runtime.Scheme.AddKnownTypes`:
  - `apis/externalsecrets/v1/register.go`: `SchemeBuilder = &scheme.Builder{GroupVersion: SchemeGroupVersion}`; `SchemeBuilder.Register(&ExternalSecret{}, &ExternalSecretList{}, &ClusterExternalSecret{}, &ClusterExternalSecretList{}, &SecretStore{}, &SecretStoreList{}, &ClusterSecretStore{}, &ClusterSecretStoreList{})` (init block lines 75-79). Breaks because underlying AddKnownTypes call will need the new struct.  
    Source: `apis/externalsecrets/v1/register.go` lines 32-80.
  - Similarly impacted: `apis/externalsecrets/v1alpha1/register.go`, `apis/externalsecrets/v1beta1/register.go`, `apis/generators/v1alpha1/register.go` (all define SchemeBuilder and Register CR types).

- **Grafana (repo: grafana)**  
  Multiple CRD API groups use `scheme.AddKnownTypes` directly in their `register.go`:
  - Example: `apps/dashboard/pkg/apis/dashboard/v1beta1/register.go` uses `scheme.AddKnownTypes(schemeGroupVersion, &Dashboard{}, &DashboardList{}, &DashboardWithAccessInfo{}, &metav1.PartialObjectMetadata{}, &metav1.PartialObjectMetadataList{})` (lines 62-69). This call will fail with the new signature.  
    Source: `apps/dashboard/pkg/apis/dashboard/v1beta1/register.go` lines 60-70.
  - Other Grafana API groups with the same pattern (metadata indicates addKnownTypes): `apps/collections/pkg/apis/collections/v1alpha1/register.go`, `apps/dashboard/pkg/apis/dashboard/v0alpha1/register.go`, `apps/dashboard/pkg/apis/dashboard/v2alpha1/register.go`, `apps/dashboard/pkg/apis/dashboard/v2beta1/register.go`, `apps/preferences/pkg/apis/preferences/v1alpha1/register.go`, `apps/provisioning/pkg/apis/provisioning/v0alpha1/register.go`, `apps/scope/pkg/apis/scope/v0alpha1/register.go`, `apps/secret/pkg/apis/secret/v1beta1/register.go`, `pkg/aggregator/apis/aggregation/register.go`, `pkg/aggregator/apis/aggregation/v0alpha1/register.go`, `pkg/apis/iam/v0alpha1/register.go`, `pkg/apis/service/v0alpha1/register.go`, `pkg/apis/userstorage/v0alpha1/register.go`.

- **OpenTelemetry Operator (repo: opentelemetry-operator)**  
  Uses controller-runtime `SchemeBuilder` with `Register`:
  - `apis/v1beta1/groupversion_info.go`: defines `SchemeBuilder = &scheme.Builder{GroupVersion: GroupVersion}`; `AddToScheme = SchemeBuilder.AddToScheme` (lines 15-22). The concrete registrations live in the type files via `init`: e.g., `apis/v1beta1/opentelemetrycollector_types.go` calls `SchemeBuilder.Register(&OpenTelemetryCollector{}, &OpenTelemetryCollectorList{})` (lines 12-14). This will fail because underlying `AddKnownTypes` must be updated.  
    Source: `apis/v1beta1/groupversion_info.go` lines 15-22; `apis/v1beta1/opentelemetrycollector_types.go` lines 12-14.
  - Similarly, `apis/v1alpha1/groupversion_info.go` and type files (e.g., `opampbridge_types.go`) use the same SchemeBuilder/Register pattern and will be affected.

SUMMARY: Changing runtime.Scheme.AddKnownTypes to require a typed TypeRegistration struct instead of variadic Object arguments will break all CRD registration code across cert-manager, external-secrets, Grafana, and OpenTelemetry Operator. Every project uses the standard pattern of calling scheme.AddKnownTypes or SchemeBuilder.Register, which internally relies on the current variadic signature. All affected files must be updated to use the new TypeRegistration-based API to avoid build failures.

FILES:
- cert-manager/pkg/apis/certmanager/v1/register.go — Calls scheme.AddKnownTypes with variadic CR objects
- cert-manager/internal/apis/acme/register.go — addKnownTypes registers Order/Challenge types via scheme.AddKnownTypes
- cert-manager/internal/apis/certmanager/register.go — addKnownTypes registers cert-manager types with scheme.AddKnownTypes
- cert-manager/internal/apis/config/cainjector/register.go — addKnownTypes registers CAInjectorConfiguration via scheme.AddKnownTypes
